Definition: properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Qal) to practice divination, divine; 1a) of diviners of the nations, Balaam; 1b) of false prophets of Israel; 1c) prohibited
